concepts.label: Water cycle definition
quotes: The water cycle describes how water moves continuously between the oceans, the air and the land.
Because it is a cycle, it has no true starting point

concepts.label: Earth's water distribution
quotes: About 97 percent of Earth's water is salt water in the oceans.
Only about 3 percent is fresh water

concepts.label: Evaporation, transpiration, and sublimation
quotes: Evaporation happens when the Sun heats liquid water and turns it into water vapour, a gas.
Transpiration is the release of water vapour from the leaves of plants.
Sublimation is when ice turns directly into water vapour without melting first

concepts.label: Condensation and cloud formation
quotes: Condensation is the opposite of evaporation: water vapour cools and turns back into tiny liquid droplets.
Clouds form when billions of these droplets gather around specks of dust in the air.

concepts.label: Precipitation
quotes: Precipitation is any water that falls from clouds to the ground, including rain, snow, sleet and hail.
Fog and dew are not precipitation

concepts.label: Runoff, infiltration, and groundwater
quotes: Runoff is water that flows over the surface into streams, rivers and eventually the sea.
Infiltration is water soaking down into the soil.
Water that soaks deep enough to fill the spaces in rock becomes groundwater

concepts.label: Human impact on the water cycle
quotes: Paving over land reduces infiltration and increases runoff
cities can flood quickly after heavy rain
